generatedFrom: Re-measured after taking the Sentry browser SDK and the Supabase realtime client off the critical path. Two static imports were doing almost all of the damage. (1) `instrumentation-client.ts` imported @sentry/nextjs at module scope, which put core+tracing+logs into rootMainFiles: every route paid 151.6 KB gzip before it could render, the login screen as much as the Payment Desk. It now loads on requestIdleCallback after `load`, with a synchronous window.onerror/unhandledrejection buffer so errors thrown during boot are still captured and replayed into the SDK when it arrives; `app/global-error.tsx` imports it inside the effect for the same reason. The cost is the pageload transaction, which tracing no longer sees. (2) `office-sync-listener.tsx` imported @/lib/supabase/client at module scope for one listener that renders null, dragging supabase-js WITH realtime (~60 KB gzip) into the eager chunk of every protected route; `voice-note-recorder.tsx` did the same to Defaulters. Both now import inside the handler that needs them. rootMainFiles: 217.6 -> 129.2 KB gzip. Route entry JS: -60 KB on every route. First-load JS (shared + route) is down ~144 KB gzip, about 35%, on all eight. Ceilings ratchet DOWN to the new figures with the usual ~1.5% runner variance, and `shared` is now gated too -- it never was, which is how half of first-load JS stayed outside the budget for the gate's whole life.

shared.note: Loaded by every route before its own entry JS. Was invisible to --check until 2026-08-13.
